title: Cartoon: the Dome of the Rock as a smiling character with arms and legs
summary: The photo of the Western Wall and Dome of the Rock again, now with a hand-drawn smiley face on the golden dome and drawn arms and legs, so the dome looks like a cartoon figure sitting on the wall. No text on the slide.

pictures.description: Photo of the Western Wall in Jerusalem with the gold-domed Dome of the Rock above it, a white minaret on the left, cypress trees on the right and a crowd in the plaza below.

Black hand-drawn cartoon overlay on the photo: a smiling face with eyebrows drawn on the golden dome, two raised arms with hands, and two legs with feet dangling down the wall, making the dome look like a smiling character sitting on the wall.
